notes: The title bar at the top of the Configurator and the setup wizard now just says HouseRunner, with the logo – the word “Configurator” has gone from it.
The HouseRunner logo’s three coloured lines are longer and thicker, so they show up properly at small sizes.

Family Admin and Family Calendar have new app icons: the HouseRunner house and lines, with a blue cog for Admin and an amber calendar for Calendar. A phone that already has the apps on its home screen may keep the old icon until the app is removed and added again.
